THE BEST OPTIMIZED HYDRO GEL

Ela-co Amphiphasic Hydro Gel

Ela

Elasticity from
Biphasic gels

Co

The cohesiveness of monophasic gels and the elasticity of biphasic gels.

AMPHEXON™ Technology is precisely engineered so the strengths of these two distinct properties achieve balance within a single hydrogel.

The result is a next-generation hydrogel optimized for the human body, with smooth injectability and stable shape retention.
